tasks.label: Deploy Backend
tasks.command: git archive HEAD backend -o backend.zip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; scp backend.zip leads:/home/newleadsprograme/; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; ssh leads "cd /home/newleadsprograme && unzip -o backend.zip && rm backend.zip"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; ssh leads "source /home/newleadsprograme/virtualenv/backend/3.13/bin/activate && cd /home/newleadsprograme/backend && python manage.py migrate"

tasks.label: Deploy Frontend
tasks.command: npm run build -- --mode prod; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; ssh leads "rm -rf ~/public_html/assets"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; scp -r .\dist\* leads:/home/newleadsprograme/public_html/; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; scp .\dist\.htaccess leads:/home/newleadsprograme/public_html/; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; ssh leads "chmod -R 755 ~/public_html/assets && chmod 755 ~/public_html/v1"
